blurb: Stash 21.0 is the September 2020 release of Morgan Houppin's C UCI chess engine, adding space evaluation, safe-square king-zone filtering, refined linear LMR, and a deterministic built-in benchmark. Adapted to UCI over WASI on the poll helper.
fidelityNotes: Single-threaded plain wasm32-wasip1 build using the C poll helper; Hash capped for 32-bit memory.

features.label: Magic Bitboards
features.implementation: 64-bit magic bitboards for sliding-piece attack generation.

features.label: PVS
features.implementation: Iterative deepening PVS with transposition-table probing in main search and quiescence search.

features.label: Null Move Pruning
features.implementation: Dynamic null-move pruning with zugzwang verification search.

features.label: Late Move Reductions
features.implementation: Linear depth-plus-move-count reductions on late moves with re-search on fail-high.

features.label: Reverse Futility & Razoring
features.implementation: Static-evaluation beta pruning and shallow razoring on non-PV nodes.

features.label: History & Killer Ordering
features.implementation: Quiet history table combined with killers, TT move, MVV-LVA, and SEE.

features.label: Transposition Table
features.implementation: Zobrist-indexed hash table caching search bounds, depths, and best moves.

features.label: King Zone Attack
features.implementation: Weighted attacks on opponent king-zone squares excluding pawn-defended squares.

features.label: Space Evaluation
features.implementation: Evaluates safe central space controlled behind friendly pawns.

features.label: Rook File Patterns
features.implementation: Bonuses for rooks on open, semi-open, and opponent-queen files.

features.label: Mobility & Endgames
features.implementation: Safe-square piece mobility, pawn structure evaluation, and specialized endgame recognizers.

features.label: Tapered Eval
features.implementation: Packed middlegame/endgame score pairs interpolated smoothly by game phase.
